[00:00] HOST: Our last guest of the season is Tomas Hale, who runs a floating shop on the river Trent.
[03:05] TOMAS: We sell bread, milk, coal and gas bottles, and the shop moves every day.
[06:40] TOMAS: A full day is forty miles, so I plan stops around the locks.
[11:30] HOST: What do boaters ask for most?
[11:40] TOMAS: Coal in winter, ice cream in summer.
[15:15] HOST: Tomas, thank you, and thank you all for the season.
